title: The Lift Was Chained Off All Night

scenes.text: THE LIFT MOVED. I CHAINED IT.
scenes.narration: The lift camera recorded forty minutes of footage last night. The lift was chained off all night. I put the chain on myself.
scenes.imagePrompt: The inside of an old office lift car, brushed steel walls, the doors closed, a heavy chain looped across the inside of the doors, no people, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: IT WENT UP. ONE FLOOR AT A TIME.
scenes.subtext: You can see the light change.
scenes.narration: The footage shows the car moving. You can see the light through the door gap change, one floor at a time.
scenes.imagePrompt: A thin line of light spilling through the gap between closed lift doors onto a steel floor, the light a different colour from the car's own ceiling panel, no people, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: A man stands in the back corner with his back to the lens. He never presses a button. The lift goes where he wants.
scenes.imagePrompt: A tall man in a long dark coat standing in the back corner of an office lift facing the wall, completely still, seen from behind, no face visible, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: THE PADLOCK WAS ON THE INSIDE
scenes.narration: This morning the chain was still across the doors. The padlock was on the inside.
